fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Miami policing and crime, traffic and congestion, and a continuing feature on the city bus ordinance and the operating agreement with the Miami Beach Railway company (a subsidiary of Florida Power & Light). Also includes business and banking commentary (including a letter comparing Miami banks’ lending practices), Miami Chamber of Commerce-related content, a bridge column by Sidney S. Lenz, local entertainment/nightlife notices, and assorted local society items, puzzles, and advertisements.
